_doc: Data-driven deterministic repair registry. The build pipeline loads this file and applies pattern-based fixes when build_gate reports the matching error_signature. Each entry is fully generic — NO module names, NO hardcoded module-specific identifiers. Patterns operate on idiom-level code shapes that appear in any module that triggers the matching rule.

_schema.error_signature: Substring matched against build_gate error text. Case-sensitive.
_schema.pattern: Python re pattern. Use named groups when needed.
_schema.replacement: re.sub replacement string. Backrefs allowed (\1 etc).
_schema.flags: Optional list of re flags: IGNORECASE, MULTILINE, DOTALL.
_schema.narrate_template: Format string. {count} = number of substitutions made.

repairs.narrate_template: RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Stripped {count} hardcoded continental-center coordinate literal(s).
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Hardened {count} row None-check(s) to also exclude empty/sentinel values.

repairs.replacement: float(\1[\2]) if \1[\2] not in ('', None, '-', 'null') else None
repairs.narrate_template: RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Wrapped {count} float(row[N]) call(s) with empty/sentinel guard.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Stripped {count} 'Region ${{lat}}' fallback prefix(es) from hero — city name must come from geocoding response.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Replaced {count} bare empty-payload return(s) with HTTPException(503) in except handlers.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Injected HTTPException into fastapi import so 503 raises compile cleanly.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Replaced {count} FIRMS country-specific code(s) with `world` — all global wildfires now visible.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Parenthesized {count} `?? value ||` operator-precedence expression(s) — prevents esbuild syntax error.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Replaced {count} `dark_nolabels`/`light_nolabels` CartoDB tile layer URL(s) with `dark_only_labels` — fixes SST color gradient visibility over ocean.

repairs.pattern: (?:View Render Failure|View Crashed|Module Rendering Error|\bView Error\b)
repairs.narrate_template: RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Replaced {count} non-canonical ErrorBoundary heading(s) with 'Module View Error'.
RULES REPAIR (deterministic): Replaced {count} non-canonical ErrorBoundary retry label(s) with 'Retry'.
